# What does a sawing hour cost you, and what should you charge per board foot?

> Free custom sawing rate calculator for portable sawmill operators: true cost per sawing hour, break-even and target quote per board foot or per hour, and which log sizes lose money. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/sawmill-custom-sawing-calculator/)
